intro: Mauritania has about 5 million people, a mix of Arab-Berber and Black African communities.

chapters.title: People
text: Arabic is official; Hassaniya Arabic is spoken widely, along with Pulaar, Soninke and Wolof. Groups include Beidane (Arab-Berber), Haratine and Black African communities. Almost everyone is Muslim.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Nouakchott, built from 1958, is home to about a third of the population.
